## Artifact Checklist

<!-- Complete this section for every artifact added or modified -->

- [ ] Frontmatter includes `id`, `type`, `title`, `created`, `authors`, and `status`
- [ ] `id` is `lowercase-kebab-case` and globally unique
- [ ] `type` matches a declared artifact type
- [ ] Dates use ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DD`)
- [ ] Cross-references use artifact `id` values, not file paths
- [ ] `status` is set appropriately (`draft`, `review`, `stable`, or `deprecated`)

---

## Review Checklist

<!-- For reviewers -->

- [ ] Factual claims are accurate and sourced where necessary
- [ ] No conflicts with existing stable artifacts
- [ ] Artifact is complete relative to what it declares
- [ ] Format complies with the schema in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Related artifacts are cross-referenced by ID
- [ ] Language is clear and unambiguous
